businesses.business: agricultural, construction and turf equipment manufacturing

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures agricultural machinery, construction and forestry equipment, and turf and compact utility equipment. Sells mainly through independent dealers to farmers, contractors and consumers, and offers precision technology and financing.

primary_products.value: agricultural tractors and combines; construction and forestry equipment; compact utility tractors and turf mowers; precision agriculture technology; replacement parts

primary_services.value: equipment financing; precision technology and fleet data subscriptions; equipment leasing and insurance

customer_segment.value: B2B: farmers, agricultural producers, construction contractors, forestry operators, landscapers; B2C: homeowners and rural landowners buying compact tractors and mowers; B2G: municipalities and public works agencies buying construction and turf equipment

end_markets.value: agriculture; construction; forestry; turf care and landscaping; infrastructure

revenue_model.value: product sales: new equipment and parts sold to dealers and customers; interest or premiums: financing interest on retail and wholesale equipment loans and leases; subscription: precision agriculture and connectivity software services
revenue_model.category: product sales; interest or premiums; subscription

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds machinery from purchased steel, components and engines, sold via dealers to farmers and contractors; financial intermediary: captive finance arm lending to dealers and customers; brand owner: owns the equipment brand and technology platforms
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; financial intermediary; brand owner

geography_served.value: global: North America, South America, Europe, Asia, Africa and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: agricultural, construction and forestry, turf equipment, plus captive financing

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent dealer network selling equipment and parts; direct sales: large-account and some government sales; online: online parts ordering and some consumer products; third-party retail: home improvement retailers selling some residential turf products
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; online; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: engine emissions rules (EPA, EU), equipment safety standards, trade rules, and financial services regulation for its finance arm
